verdict.rationale: Decagon's docs mention that technical teams get "full visibility and control over guardrails, integrations, and versioning" and offer AOPs/testing/experiments for iterating on agent logic, implying some version-control-like workflow, but there is no concrete evidence of a review workflow, diff/version history UI, or an explicit rollback mechanism for automations. missing for 10: explicit rollback feature, version history/diff UI, review/approval workflow evidence.
